name: Mesugaki Summer Life
original_name: メスガキサマーライフ
source:
Your younger sister, Tsukino Yuzuha, is an excellent student who excels in both academics and sports. Due to this stark contrast, you, an ordinary brother, have kept your distance from her. After the school's closing ceremony, you returned home and accidentally caught a glimpse of your sister in her underwear.

"You get excited by seeing your little sister in her underwear, Onii-chan?"

However, that honor student sister of yours... turns out to be a cheeky brat!

"Onii-chan, your summer vacation belongs to Yuzu."

Now, with this cheeky brat having leverage over you, and you being at her mercy... a sweet and naughty summer vacation between the two of you begins.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01011233.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
你的妹妹月乃柚叶是一位在学业和体育方面都表现出色的优秀学生。正是因为这样的鲜明对比，你这个普通的兄弟才与她保持了距离。放学典礼结束后，你回到家，无意间看到了穿着内衣的妹妹。

“哥哥，看到妹妹穿着内衣，你会兴奋吗？”

不过你那个优等生妹妹……原来是个厚脸皮的臭小子啊！

“哥哥，你的暑假是属于柚子的。”

现在，这个厚脸皮的小子对你有影响力，而你却任由她摆布……你们两个甜蜜而调皮的暑假开始了。
